name: Site Studio ACSF
description: Switches Site Studio (Acquia Cohesion) template and stylesheet storage from the filesystem to the database, for distributed-filesystem/multisite platforms such as Acquia Site Factory.
project_description: A utility module that makes Acquia Site Studio (Cohesion) store its generated Twig templates and stylesheet JSON in the database (KeyValue storage) instead of on the filesystem, which is the current default. This targets hosting platforms with a distributed or per-site filesystem — notably Acquia Site Factory — where rapid file read/write of Site Studio's generated assets can produce inconsistent behaviour. The module aliases the cohesion.template_storage service to the KeyValue implementation and forces the cohesion.settings stylesheet_json_storage_keyvalue flag on via a config override. After enabling it a full Site Studio rebuild (drush cohesion:rebuild, or /admin/cohesion/developer/rebuild) is required to migrate existing templates into the database. Database usage grows in exchange for read/write consistency.
